title: RPS positive control reproduced (May-Leonard lattice: coexistence below M~3e-4, extinction above ~1e-3); three-kind Gray-Scott replicators: the transitive twin goes to one kind, cyclic predation does not, but strong cyclic predation kills all three
summary: Positive control: a C kernel (ml.c) of the Reichenbach-Mobilia-Frey lattice May-Leonard model (sigma=mu=1, Gillespie-equivalent random sequential update, time = generations). At t=N, 0/40 runs went extinct for M<=2e-4 at L=50 and 100 (0/20 at L=100, M=3e-4), and extinction rises to 0.85-1.0 by M=2e-3; spirals form with a wavelength that grows with M (ml_snaps.png, L=200). The L=50 and L=100 curves cross near 4.5e-4 as published, but the L=100 curve rises more slowly above it (0.35 at 7e-4) than the paper's step, so M_c is reproduced only to within a factor of about 2. Main world: three Gray-Scott autocatalyst kinds on one regrowing feed (F=0.024, K=0.058, a spot birth/death regime found by screen.py; the mitosis regime freezes into a lattice where spots never touch, so predation never acts), with predation V_i+V_j -> (1+Y)V_i (Y=0.5) switched on at t=3000. At P=0.5, 2/2 seeds: the transitive twin (0 eats 1 and 2, 1 eats 2) drives kind 0 from 0.28-0.29 to 0.73-0.77 of spots by t=30000, the no-predation twin stays within 0.2-0.4, and the cyclic arm has no fixed winner (kind-0 share 0.1 and 0.42 at t=30000). At P>=1 the cyclic arm loses all three kinds within ~1000 t of switch-on (seed 1, P=1 and 3; seed 1 at P=3 without delay too), while the transitive twin keeps kind 0 (p3_transitive). So cyclic predation does change population dynamics against both twins, but spots touch rarely and the coexistence-vs-domain-size law was not reached: this is the reaction-diffusion baseline only (E by construction).

finding.operator: cyclic vs transitive predation between Gray-Scott spot kinds on one feed
finding.control: matched transitive and no-predation twins, same seeds, grid and duration; lattice May-Leonard positive control from the literature
finding.result: transitive: kind-0 share 0.28->0.77 (seed1), 0.29->0.73 (seed2); none: 0.2-0.4 flat; cyclic: 0.10 and 0.42 at t=30000, no winner; cyclic at P>=1 total extinction. May-Leonard P_ext(t=N)=0 for M<=2e-4 (L=50,100), 0.30-0.35 at 4.5e-4, 0.85-1.0 at 2e-3.
